column3: An envelope seen from the front; its triangular flap is drawn as the hands of a clock pointing up and to the right, with a small marigold dot at the clock centre. One bold continuous shape, white envelope on the plum background.

A bold geometric capital letter D whose inner hollow is an open filing tray; a single white paper card is sliding down into it, the card's top edge has a marigold tab. The D is white, built from thick rounded strokes.

A white paper letter card, slightly rotated, encircled by a thick marigold circular progress ring that is about three-quarters complete, like a countdown timer around the letter. Clean, flat, high contrast.
A white envelope whose V-shaped flap line is drawn as a bold check mark, with a small round marigold notification badge on the top-right corner of the envelope. Ultra simple, flat, two shapes only.

A white letter card with a marigold calendar ribbon tab clipped over its top edge (like a page marker with two small binder rings), and one bold plum dot on the card marking the due day. Soft dimensional paper feel.
